title: Why Can't You Tickle Yourself?
screenDirection: Camera holds the character's near (screen-right) side for the whole piece. The external hand enters from the foreground on that same side, so it never crosses the axis. Face, incoming hand and rib contact stay visible together.
framingRule: Chest-up, three-quarter. Character occupies 55-70% of frame during the explanation. Look-at ~1.05m, distance ~2.4-2.6m, fov ~34.

states.name: predictionFocus
states.intent: Reveal the forward model leading the real hand.

states.name: sensorySuppression
states.contours: rib contour compresses then damps to nothing
states.intent: The predicted touch is canceled; the tickle fails visibly.

states.name: unexpectedBurst
states.intent: An unpredicted touch lands; no ghost precedes it.

states.name: resolution
states.intent: The laugh settles; the field is calm.

camera.movement: gentle medium-close push on the near 3/4
camera.notes: No distant establish. Opens already close on the character.
Hold so the ghost reach is unmistakable.

performance.pose: selfTickle: right hand to ribs, fingers wiggle clearly
performance.notes: Reaction stays tiny — the point is it will fail.

effects.purpose: Translucent violet ghost HAND travels handRight→ribRight, arriving ~0.3s before the real hand, then dissolves before contact. THE unforgettable visual.
Head→hand signal: the brain issuing the forward model.

text.content: Your brain predicts your own touch.

performance.pose: fingers still wiggling at ribs, body relaxed, no squirm
performance.notes: Obvious failure: the tickle produces almost nothing.

effects.purpose: Rib contour compresses inward and damps to nothing — the sensation is canceled.

camera.notes: External hand enters from foreground right. NO ghost appears — the comparison.

effects.purpose: External hand travels in from the foreground; unpredicted, so no prediction visual precedes it.

camera.notes: Face + hand + rib contact all in frame.

performance.pose: still relaxed at the instant of contact
performance.notes: Reaction is delayed until just after contact.

effects.purpose: External hand does two fast finger curls at the ribs (motion.object.curl).

performance.pose: playful squirm: torso twist, shoulder compression, bent knees, defensive arm pull-in
performance.notes: Eased onset. Delighted flinch, NOT electrocution or pain.

effects.purpose: Pink→white reaction burst at the ribs; light spikes.

camera.notes: Only move now, at the release.
